about: The MCP servers the compatibility run cages (test/compat/run.mjs), in the order of their npm downloads. How they were chosen, and what each result means, is in docs/compatibility.md. Fields: package, npx (npx's flags, default -y), args ({dir} is a fresh folder with one file, hello.txt), mounts, files (more files for that folder), env (given with --env: dummy keys for servers that refuse to start without one, or a setting), call (one harmless tool call; expect is text its answer must hold, {base} the folder's name), expected (ok, needs network, fails, build fails), notes.

servers.name: playwright
servers.notes: Lists its tools. Its browser tools need a browser, which the cage does not have: install scripts are off, and nothing is downloaded when it runs.

servers.name: pdf
servers.notes: Started as its README writes it, with npx --silent.

servers.name: chrome-devtools
servers.notes: Lists its tools. It drives an installed Google Chrome, which the cage does not have.

servers.name: filesystem
servers.notes: The folder is mounted read-only. On Windows the server sees it at /c/Users/...

servers.name: mcp-remote
servers.notes: A bridge to a remote server, here DeepWiki's, which needs no key. It connects when it starts, so it needs --allow-net.

servers.name: context7
servers.notes: Lists its tools without the network; its calls fetch documentation and need --allow-net.

servers.name: desktop-commander
servers.notes: Lists its tools. Its commands need a shell, and the cage's image has none.

servers.name: notion
servers.notes: Starts without a token.

servers.name: memory
servers.notes: Keeps its graph next to its code, which is read-only in the cage: to write, set MEMORY_FILE_PATH to a file in a :rw mount.

servers.name: hostinger
servers.notes: Starts without a token.

servers.name: sentry
servers.notes: Refuses to start without a token, so it is given a dummy one.

servers.name: gitlab
servers.notes: Refuses to start without a token, so it is given a dummy one.

servers.name: pandacss
servers.notes: Reads the Panda project of its working directory, which in the cage is the image's /app: it is given --cwd and the project's folder.

servers.name: supabase
servers.notes: Refuses to start without a token, so it is given a dummy one, and fetches from Supabase's API to answer tools/list.

servers.name: github
servers.notes: Archived reference server. Starts without a token.

servers.name: mongodb
servers.notes: Starts without a connection string.

servers.name: slack
servers.notes: Archived reference server. Refuses to start without a token and a team id, so it is given dummy ones.

servers.name: azure
servers.notes: A .NET program that needs ICU, which the cage's image does not have: DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=1 lets it run without.

servers.name: figma
servers.notes: Refuses to start without a key, so it is given a dummy one.

servers.name: postgres
servers.notes: Archived reference server. Starts with a database it cannot reach, and connects only to answer a query.

servers.name: firecrawl
servers.notes: Starts without a key.
